overall_reason: A small, role-named colour set (--ink, --muted, --accent, --line) drives 97% of colour declarations and the dark theme swaps all 18 semantic colour names, but the mono label type runs in half-pixel steps (9.5, 10, 10.5, 11px) and spacing is typed per element with 28 values.

score.reason: T-THEME-PARITY and T-TOKEN-TIERS pass on colour; T-DRIFT-PAIRS and T-SCALE-FIT fail on the label sizes and the literal spacing (TOK-010, TOK-003, TOK-002).

findings.evidence: The tracked mono labels use four sizes half a pixel apart: the brand subline 'DIAGRAMDESIGN.DEV' is 9.5px (96 elements), the mode switch 10px (26), the figure labels 10.5px (15) and the top nav links 11px (34) (values.1440.font_size, near_duplicates 9.5/10, 10/10.5, 10.5/11). The sweep's type_ladder hit counts 19 sizes.
findings.before: 9.5, 10, 10.5 and 11px on one kind of label
findings.after: One label size (for example 10px) and one nav size, set as two tokens
findings.why: The eye cannot tell 10 from 10.5px, so the four sizes add upkeep without adding hierarchy.

findings.evidence: Running text uses 12, 12.5, 13, 14, 15, 16, 16.5 and 17px (values.1440.font_size): the code sample is 12.5px, the sheet footers 13px, the deltas list 15px and the card descriptions 14px. The best ratio fit is 1.067, which fits by chance (share_on 1.0 against chance 0.512). All 51 font-size declarations are literals.
findings.before: Eight text sizes between 12 and 17px, typed per rule
findings.after: A five-step type scale declared once and referenced
findings.why: Without a scale, each new section picks its own size and the half-pixel steps keep growing.

findings.evidence: Spacing is written as 107 literal declarations with no spacing token, and 28 distinct values render, with pairs 1px apart: 11 and 12px (196 and 28 elements), 8 and 9px (18 and 57), 15 and 16px (6 and 78) (values.1440.spacing near_duplicates). The sweep's off_scale_spacing hit lists 12 off-scale values.
findings.after: One 4px-based spacing scale; 11px gaps become 12 and 9px gaps become 8
findings.why: Gaps 1px apart in the same kind of panel read as error, not as intent.

strengths: Colour is a small semantic set (--bg, --ink, --muted, --accent, --line, --panel) referenced in 150 of 154 colour declarations.
The dark theme redefines every base semantic colour token under one class selector, with no literal colours in dark rules (theme.semantic_colour_redefined_share 1.0).
One accent (#bf4520) carries every highlight, and there is no radius or shadow family to drift.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
the dark theme as rendered: the capture shows the light scheme only
the diagram SVGs are exhibits; their internal values were not judged
